Incident history (6)

📅 2025-05-17 Direct Strike (Vicinity) INC-185
surgical operations suspended due to damage to hospital generator and other departments

On 17 May, an IDP tent adjacent to Al Kuwaiti Field Hospital was reportedly hit, killing six Palestinians. The hospital announced the suspension of surgical operations until further notice due to severe damage to the hospital’s generator and other departments. On 19 May, following partial repairs, the hospital announced the resumption of operations in the surgical department for emergency cases only.

📅 2024-05-27 Ceased operations INC-182
Ceased operations on 27 May, two staff killed near hospital gate

Al Kuwaiti Hospital in Rafah ceased operations on 27 May; according to media reports quoting the hospital’s director, this occurred after two medical staff were killed when the hospital’s gate was hit.

2 health workers killed

📅 2023-12-19 Airstrike (Vicinity) INC-245
Israeli military bombarded the area near the hospital

Al Jazeera correspondent Hani Mahmoud was reporting live when an Israeli missile strike pounded buildings behind him. He continued to report as people fled the scene, close to the Kuwaiti Hospital in a densely populated residential area in Rafah in southern Gaza.

Sources: 🔗 aljazeera
